title: Jaundice as Initial Presentation of Liver Hydatidosis (ICTEHIDA)
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate patients with hepatic hydatidosis whose symptom at diagnosis was obstructive jaundice. As well as analyzing, the rate of performing preoperative ERCP, the results after surgery and morbidity
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hepatic Hydatidosis with obstructive jaundice surgically treated

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with conservative treatment
study_population: Patients operated on hydatidic cyst, any surgical option
